dimension_edges.evidence_quote: Augmented data storytelling enhances narrative delivery by integrating visualizations with physical environments and presenter actions.

dimension_edges.pattern_summary: At least one end of the interaction loop lives in matter rather than pixels: objects are grasped, moved, or posed to issue commands, or the system's output is delivered as physical motion, staged space, or a tangible arrangement.
dimension_edges.evidence_quote: We introduce augmented physical data storytelling, an approach enabling presenters to manipulate visualizations through physical object interactions.

candidates.title: Embodied Laugh Track: Supporting VR Comedy Viewing Experience with Multimodal Laughter from Virtual Audience

dimension_edges.pattern_summary: The agent is given a rendered body — an animated character, a 3-D figure, an on-screen avatar, a participant tile — and the user addresses that figure rather than a text pane.
dimension_edges.evidence_quote: The system’s virtual audiences express laughter through facial expressions, body movements, and vocal sounds in response to detected humorous moments in the content.

dimension_edges.pattern_summary: One unit of system output is rendered in two or more sensory or representational channels at once — text plus speech, text plus image plus sound, or one language plus another.
dimension_edges.evidence_quote: In our design, we incorporated visual (A, B) and auditory (C) cues into the avatar’s interface.
